swe: André Kalmendal är doktorand i psykologi. I sin avhandling granskar han John Hatties välkända lista över “Synligt lärande”. I detta arbete läser och granskar han tusentals vetenskapliga litteraturöversikter, samt utvecklar ett sätt att öppet dela och göra dem interaktiva och möjliga att uppdatera. Han genomför även nya systematiska översikter. André arbetar framförallt med den forskarinriktade CAMA-plattformen.
eng: André Kalmendal is a PhD student in psychology. In his dissertation, he reviews John Hattie's well-known "Visible Learning". Within this project, André is reading and reviewing thousands of scientific literature reviews, as well as developing a method to openly share systematic reviews and make them interactive and updatable. He also conducts new systematic reviews. André mainly works with the researcher-oriented CAMA platform.
